## Summary Register the **megaswap-elizaos-plugin** (v1.0.0) — a plugin for trading tokens on MegaETH via [MegaSwap DEX](https://megaswap.xyz). ### Plugin Details - **Package**: [`megaswap-elizaos-plugin`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/megaswap-elizaos-plugin) (v1.0.0) - **GitHub**: [jacksun911/megaswap-elizaos-plugin](https://github.com/jacksun911/megaswap-elizaos-plugin) - **Actions (9)**: swap, get quotes, list pairs, check balances, manage liquidity, list tokens - **Network**: MegaETH ### Changes - Added `"megaswap-elizaos-plugin": "github:jacksun911/megaswap-elizaos-plugin"` to `index.json` in alphabetical order ## Summary by CodeRabbit ## Release Notes * **Chores** * Added package registration for megaswap-elizaos-plugin to the package index.

Greptile Summary

This PR adds a single entry for `megaswap-elizaos-plugin` to `index.json`, registering a DEX swap plugin for the MegaETH network. The entry follows the correct `github:owner/repo` format, has no `.git` extension, and is alphabetically placed between the last `@`-scoped entry and the existing `plugin-*` entries.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge — single-line addition to index.json with correct format and placement. The change is minimal: one key/value pair added in the correct alphabetical position, using the required github: scheme, no .git suffix, and the JSON remains valid. Format matches all checklist requirements in the PR template. No logic, security, or structural concerns. No files require special attention.
